dogecoin.text:
Someone please tell me we have not reached a point in this cycle where Mark Cuban is saying Dogecoin is legitimate.

What the hell is wrong with people.
If Dogecoin doesn’t show you we need to immediately re-brand as #sats I don’t know what to tell you.

Dismissing dogecoin shitcoiners as ignorant is lazy and misses an opportunity.

Hyperbitcoinization can only happen when 64 year old high school dropouts want to and easily can acquire Bitcoin.

Build something that makes that possible if you can, educate if you can’t.
